name: Chain of Blows
description: Successful Attacks and abilities against enemies add to your Combo. Each time Combo reaches 8, you gain a Shield as well as Movement Speed and Strength.

name: Prana Onslaught
description: Throw a powerful punch, projecting your prana to deal Physical Damage and Slow enemies in front of you.

name: Overhead Kick
description: Kick high, sending a shockwave forward that deals Physical Damage to all enemies in a line. Gain Movement Speed and become CC Immune and Damage Immune for the duration.

name: 10-Hand Shadow Fist
description: Fire your fists forward, dealing Physical Damage as they pass through enemies. The first enemy god hit is Rooted. Heal from the first enemy god and the first 3 minions hit.

name: Mystic Rush
description: Become CC Immune and Leap to a target location, dealing Physical Damage to enemies in the area. Enemy gods hit take increased Damage from all sources. After landing, you gain Damage Mitigation for a duration.
